column1: # The universe table -- one row per supported runtime era.  This file is the
# single source of truth for universe names; mkuniverse.py generates
# universe.h from it (make -C src/common), and cc/cpp/ld/apsim all resolve
# names against that header.  Canonical names are short and period-free.
#   name    canonical universe name (what PDP11_UNIVERSE / --universe take)
#   id      small integer id, stable once assigned
#   status  full = a compile target: the universal libc + headers serve it and
#           tests pass; sim = apsim runs this era's native binaries (verified)
#           but it is not a compile target; planned = registered, not yet proven.
#           The "full" set is the V7-syscall-convention family (V5..2.9BSD),
#           which the one universal libc serves; 2.10/2.11 use the 4BSD stack-
#           arg convention and remain sim until the libc dispatches it.
#   kern    apsim kernel personality (era-ascending: v1 v56 v7 sys3 ultrix
#           bsd2x bsd210 bsd211); the syscall table/shapes apsim presents
#   aliases comma-separated accepted spellings, or - for none

column6: First Edition UNIX (1971-72); 0405 binaries, KE11-A, 1971 trap conventions
Second Edition UNIX (1972); 0405 format, V1 personality; sources in ~/unix/v2
Third Edition UNIX (1973); no complete source tree staged
Fourth Edition UNIX (1973), first C kernel; sources in ~/unix/v4
Fifth Edition UNIX (1974); universal libc compiles+runs here (root in ~/unix/v5)
Sixth Edition UNIX (1975); universal libc compiles+runs here (root in ~/unix/v6)
Seventh Edition UNIX (1979); the canonical syscall numbering the V7-family libc uses
2.8BSD (1981), Ritchie cc era; FP11 D-format floating point
2.9BSD (1983), overlays and split I&D; the default universe
2.10BSD (1987), 4.3-style numbering; the universal libc's 4BSD-convention personality serves it (root in ~/bsd/2.10)
2.11BSD pl431 (2000), 4.4-style numbering + stack args; the universal libc's 4BSD personality; porting base for new tools
UNIX System III (1980), PDP-11 line; sources in ~/unix/sys3
System V Release 2 (1984), the last SysV with PDP-11 support; table groundable from ~/unix/svr2 (VAX kit)
DEC Ultrix-11 2.0 (1984); binary tape staged in ~/unix/ultrix11/2.0; 1.0 survives as docs only (lineage root = V7M)
DEC Ultrix-11 3.1 (1986), V7 line + fcntl/ulimit/utssys; staged in ~/unix/ultrix11 (from TUHS)
